brief.zh: 向敌人发射 4 颗豌豆，概率释放叶绿素效果

description.en: Mega Gatling Peas fire 4 peas at one time.
description.zh: 超级机枪豌豆射手每次发射 4 颗豌豆。

chat.en: "I used to be an upgrade," says Mega Gatling Pea with uncharacteristic shyness."Now I'm my own plant, with my own ambitions, dreams and gym club memberships!"
chat.zh: “我曾经是某株植物的升级款，”超级机枪豌豆非常害羞地说，“但是我现在是一株独立的植物了,我有自己的志向、梦想，还有健身房会员！”

text.en: upgrades to 5x firing speed if Plant Fooded
text.zh: 使用叶绿素后，升级成为5倍射速

text.en: has chance to randomly Plant Food himself
text.zh: 有概率自己发动叶绿素效果
